title: Grateful Dead Live at Sacramento Memorial Auditorium on 1972-08-12
lineage: Will Boswell's reel @ 3.75ips > Apogee DAC> Apogee Mini Me Wavelab 5.0 @ 24 bit 96kHz; Edited and Mastered on the **GEMS** Edit Station Weiss-Saracon for Pow-r3 Dither MetaData with Tag and Rename TLH for FLAC Level 8
source: master reel @7.5ips> J.Garcia's reel @ 3.75ips > Will Boswell's reel @ 3.75ips

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a good mix despite some cuts and unevenness, capturing a high‑energy show highlighted by “Cumberland”, “Truckin” and a soaring “Playin’ in the Band”.
ai_review.review: The performance is lively and fun, with the band feeding off a rowdy crowd; standout moments include a blazing “Cumberland”, a tight “Truckin”, and an orbital “Playin’ in the Band”. The Bear‑mixed soundboard tape is generally clear but suffers from occasional uneven balance and noticeable cuts (El Paso, Jack Straw, GSET).

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five reviewers give 4+ stars and praise the musical energy and several standout songs; recording issues are noted but not severe enough to outweigh the strong show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great Bear mix overall, though reviewers mention an uneven mix in places, minor sound glitches, and missing portions of El Paso, Tennessee Jed and Jack Straw (plus a brief GSET cut).

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set moves smoothly between high‑tempo rockers and more exploratory jams, with the second set building momentum and delivering strong transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers solid solos, perfect riffs on several numbers, and is ‘fully in the driver’s seat’ during high‑energy jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh “bombs” into the TO (Truckin) jam, providing powerful bass foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir sings confidently and even chastises flashbulb‑wielding fans; his rhythm work is solid throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s jazzy influence is noted as a fresh addition, marking his formal introduction on this night.
band_member_comments.Drums: A brief but effective drum segment follows the “Gone” jam, adding to the flow.
